title: Blog Card — List
description:
The post row the live blog landing and every category archive render. A one-third featured image on the LEADING edge and a two-thirds body column trailing it, LEFT-aligned: the title, a single italic byline reading date, author and categories, the excerpt, and a rule above the tags. A rule closes each row.

Re-measured 2026-08-26 from `.blog #primary .post-wrapper .entry-layout`, because the first port had the composition inverted. Two things were read off the DOM order and are wrong there: (1) lsx-blog-customizer sets `flex-direction: row-reverse` on `.entry-layout` at >=768px (lsx-blog-customizer.css, `.lsx-body-list-layout article.post:not(.no-thumb) .entry-layout`), so the image markup that comes LAST renders FIRST — image leading, body trailing; and (2) every `text-align: center` on the title, byline, categories and excerpt sits inside `@media (max-width: 767px)` in sd-lsx-child/custom.css, so live is left-aligned on desktop and centred only on a phone. The first port carried body-leading and centred-everywhere, which is neither state.

Measurements that stand: image flex-basis 31.5% with min-height 250px (>=768px), title #60483b, byline and categories italic. Live renders the featured image twice — once inside the header, once as the trailing column — and swaps them at the breakpoint: `.entry-layout > entry-layout-content .entry-image` is `display:none` above 768px and the trailing one carries `hidden-xs` below it. One bound image serves both states here, so the swap is a reorder rather than a duplicate. The small-breakpoint stack and the tag rule's `#` glyph live in assets/styles/core-group.css: the css field silently unwraps @media, and drops any rule containing content:"". The byline's "Posted in:" is held at regular weight with !important: assets/styles/core-post-terms.css bolds every `.wp-block-post-terms__prefix` at (0,1,0) and a css-field rule compiles to `:root :where(…)` at the same specificity, so load order would otherwise decide it. Live's byline is uniformly italic and unbolded; the tag row's "Tags:" keeps the bold, which live also has.

styles.css: & .wp-block-post-terms__prefix { font-style: italic; font-weight: var(--wp--custom--font-weight--regular) !important; } & .wp-block-post-author__content { display: flex; flex-flow: row nowrap; gap: 0.3em; } & .wp-block-post-author p { margin: 0; } & .wp-block-post-author__byline { font-size: inherit; }
